title: Optimal Risk Sharing Without Preference Convexity: An Aggregate Convexity Approach
abstract: arXiv:2509.08832v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider the optimal risk sharing problem with a continuum of agents, modeled via a non-atomic measure space. Individual preferences are not assumed to be convex. We show the multiplicity of agents induces the value function to be convex, allowing for the application of convex duality techniques to risk sharing without preference convexity. A computationally tractable formula for the conjugate of the value function is derived, yielding an explicit dual representation of the value function. Applications of our results include a version of the two fundamental theorems of welfare economics for a large class of non-convex preferences, and non-existence results for Pareto optima when preferences are distortion risk measures whose corresponding distortion function fails to majorize the identity.

translated_title: 无偏好凸性下的最优风险分担：一种聚合凸性方法
translated_abstract: 我们考虑一个由连续统代理人组成的最优风险分担问题，该问题通过非原子测度空间建模。个体偏好不假设为凸的。我们表明，代理人的多样性导致值函数变得凸，从而允许在没有偏好凸性的情况下应用凸对偶技术进行风险分担。我们推导出值函数共轭的一个计算上可处理的公式，给出了值函数的显式对偶表示。我们结果的应用包括：对于一大类非凸偏好，福利经济学两个基本定理的一个版本；以及当偏好为扭曲风险度量且相应的扭曲函数未能主导恒等函数时，帕累托最优不存在的结果。
tldr: 本文提出一种聚合凸性方法，证明在非凸偏好下通过代理人多样性可实现风险分担的凸对偶求解，并给出显式公式及福利经济学应用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an aggregate convexity approach, showing that agent multiplicity induces convexity in risk sharing without preference convexity, yielding explicit dual formulas and welfare economics applications.
